title: Setting up a step-up: six steps
objectives: Walk through the six steps to set up a step-up.
Explain where a bonus or windfall fits.
body_md:
Setting up a step-up takes six steps, and skipping any one of them creates a problem later.

1. Pick the type: fixed amount or percentage; yearly is simplest to explain.
2. Set a cap, where the AMC allows one, so the instalment stops rising at a comfortable level.
3. Check the bank mandate: it must cover the highest future instalment.
4. Existing SIP? Check whether adding a step-up means cancelling and re-registering, and whether exit-load terms change.
5. Time it: step up just after the client's annual raise.
6. No facility, or the client prefers control? Start a second, smaller SIP each year instead.

## Bonuses and windfalls

Use a lump sum or an STP alongside the step-up, not instead of it. A bonus is irregular; a step-up is the habit that runs every year.

## What goes in the note

The rule (type, rate, frequency), the cap, the month it applies, the mandate limit, and the review date.
example: A client with a bonus of ₹4 lakh sets a 5% step-up in April, keeps the emergency fund topped up first, and puts the bonus through a three-month STP — the step-up runs alongside it.
say: Let's set the type, the cap and the mandate limit, and time it to your raise.
A bonus is a one-off; we'll use an STP for it and keep the step-up running.
never: Set the step-up as high as possible and we'll sort the mandate later.
A bonus replaces the need for a step-up.

o: The maximum instalment, beyond which the step-up stops rising
The maximum return the fund can earn
The maximum number of SIPs allowed
check.why: A cap stops the instalment rising at a level the client finds comfortable.

check.q: Why must the bank mandate be checked?
o: Because it must cover the highest future instalment
Because it sets the fund's return
Because it decides the exit load
Because the AMC requires a new mandate every year
check.why: A mandate that only covers today's amount will fail on a future, higher instalment.

check.q: What should be done with a bonus?
o: Use a lump sum or STP alongside the step-up
Use it to start a sectoral SIP
check.why: A bonus is irregular; the step-up is the annual habit. Use both.
